description: She wears an opaque deep red patterned floor length gown with a low square neckline and fitted bodice, decorated with gold woven trim along neckline, sleeves, waist, skirt opening and hem. A cream patterned underdress shows through the central lower opening. A gold brown shoulder wrap with red borders rests around her forearms and hangs down both sides. A narrow decorated belt gathers the waist; a small pendant and drop earrings provide restrained jewelry. Her hands rest together in front, brown leather shoes appear beneath the skirt, and her head is bare.
